n6e836df370c.s: The Indian Science Congress Association (ISCA) is headquartered at:
n6e836df370c.x: ISCA's headquarters is in Kolkata, not New Delhi.

n874e4a6aba6.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: National Council of Science Museums – Ministry of Culture
n874e4a6aba6.x: NCSM, formed on 4 April 1978 with headquarters at Kolkata, is under the Ministry of Culture. Vigyan Prasar, Vigyan Rail and NIF are all linked to DST.

ne6f5728a312.s:
Consider the following statements about INSPIRE-SHE:
1. SHE stands for Scholarship for Higher Education.
2. It is meant for top-ranked UG and PG students in natural and basic sciences.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
ne6f5728a312.x: SHE is the Scholarship for Higher Education for top UG and PG science students, so it targets higher education, not school students.

n25f91408d3d.s: Which DST scheme has set up STI Hubs for SC/ST communities?
n25f91408d3d.x: SEED has set up STI Hubs for SC/ST communities; GATI works on institutional gender equity and CURIE on women PG colleges.

n94164ecbdfb.s: The supercomputer PARAM Shivay is hosted at:
n94164ecbdfb.x: PARAM Shivay is at IIT (BHU) Varanasi; PARAM Brahma is at IISER Pune, PARAM Pravega at IISc and PARAM Ganga at IIT Roorkee.

ne9a9b1ef3c0.s: The RDI Scheme, approved by the Union Cabinet on 1 July 2025, provides:
ne9a9b1ef3c0.x: The RDI Scheme provides ₹1 lakh crore over six years, steered by the ANRF Governing Board with DST as nodal department.

n25c75e1159d.s:
Consider the following statements about AIRAWAT:
1. It is an artificial-intelligence supercomputer associated with the National Supercomputing Mission.
2. It is located at NCMRWF, Noida.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n25c75e1159d.x: AIRAWAT is the NSM's AI supercomputer, but it is located at C-DAC, Pune, not NCMRWF Noida.

n5979af149e2.s: Which of the following is NOT a target of the National Quantum Mission?
o: Satellite QKD over 2000 km within India
Development of magnetometers and atomic clocks
Intermediate-scale quantum computers of 50-1000 physical qubits
Indigenous Rudra server boards for supercomputers
n5979af149e2.x: The Rudra server board belongs to the National Supercomputing Mission; QKD, quantum sensing and 50-1000 qubit computers are NQM targets.

new.s: The Indian Academy of Sciences (IASc), Bengaluru, was founded in 1934 by:
new.x: C.V. Raman founded IASc in 1934; Meghnad Saha founded NASI in 1930.

new.s: The Indian National Science Academy (INSA), New Delhi, was originally founded in 1935 as:
o: National Institute of Sciences of India
new.x: INSA began in 1935 as the National Institute of Sciences of India and was renamed in 1970.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Indian science academies:
1. NASI was founded before IASc.
2. INSA is headquartered at Bengaluru.
3. IASc was founded by C.V. Raman.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: NASI (1930) came before IASc (1934), which Raman founded; INSA is headquartered at New Delhi, not Bengaluru.

new.s: The 108th Indian Science Congress (January 2023) was held at:
new.x: The 108th session was held at RTM Nagpur University on S&T for sustainable development with women empowerment.

new.s: Gyan Darshan, launched on 26 January 2000, is run by the MHRD with Prasar Bharati and:
new.x: Gyan Darshan is run by the MHRD with IGNOU and Prasar Bharati; Vyas is the UGC-CEC channel.

new.s: SWAYAM Prabha, the free DTH educational service launched in 2017, has how many channels?
new.x: SWAYAM Prabha offers 32 free DTH channels under the Ministry of Education.

new.s: DD Science and India Science were launched together on:
new.x: The two Vigyan Prasar platforms were launched on 15 January 2019.

new.s: National Technology Day, observed on 11 May, commemorates:
new.x: National Technology Day (11 May) marks the Pokhran-II tests of 1998 and was declared in 1999.

new.s: The 11th India International Science Festival (December 2025) was held at:
new.x: The 11th IISF was held at Panchkula on 6-9 December 2025.

new.s: The Festival of Innovation (FOIN), linked with the National Innovation Foundation, is held at:
new.x: NIF's Festival of Innovation is held at Rashtrapati Bhavan.

new.s: In the DST scheme FIST, the letters stand for:
o: Fund for Improvement of S&T Infrastructure
Facility for Innovation in Science and Technology
Fund for Innovation and Scientific Talent
Facility for Improvement of Scientific Training
new.x: FIST is the Fund for Improvement of S&T Infrastructure in universities and higher institutions.

new.s: Which DST programme, begun in 2009, supports research only in universities?
new.x: PURSE (Promotion of University Research and Scientific Excellence) is university-only research support from 2009.

new.s: Which DST programme gives researchers access to costly analytical instruments through Sophisticated Analytical Instrument Facilities?
new.x: SAIF stands for Sophisticated Analytical Instrument Facilities, which give access to costly instruments.

new.s: The Ramalingaswami Re-entry Fellowship for life-science returnees is awarded by:
new.x: Ramalingaswami is a DBT (not DST) fellowship for life-science and biotech returnees only.

new.s: The Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF), started in 2018, is run by the:
new.x: PMRF is a Ministry of Education scheme for PhD scholars in IITs, IISc and IISERs.

new.s: BioCARe, for women biotech scientists after a career break, is a scheme of:
new.x: BioCARe is a DBT scheme; WISE-KIRAN is the DST career-break scheme.

new.s: In INSPIRE, AORC (INSPIRE Fellowship and Faculty) stands for:
new.x: AORC is the Assured Opportunity for Research Careers, covering doctoral and post-doctoral researchers.

new.s: VIPNET, a network of science clubs, is run by:
new.x: VIPNET is Vigyan Prasar's network of science clubs.

new.s: ARISE under the Atal Innovation Mission is aimed at:
new.x: ARISE (Atal Research and Innovation for Small Enterprises) targets MSMEs; ACICs serve rural areas.

new.s: The central hub of Andhra Pradesh's Ratan Tata Innovation Hub is at:
new.x: RTIH's central hub is at Mangalagiri (Amaravati) with spokes at Visakhapatnam, Rajahmundry, Vijayawada-Guntur, Tirupati and Anantapur.

new.s: The Ratan Tata Innovation Hub was set up as a Section-8 company by:
new.x: The Andhra Pradesh Innovation Society (APIS) set up RTIH, inaugurated on 20 August 2025.

new.s: How many Atal Tinkering Labs did Andhra Pradesh have in 2024-25?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh had 590 ATLs in 2024-25.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched with its body?
o: Fund of Funds for Startups – SIDBI
Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups – NCGTC
new.x: NIDHI (2016) is a DST initiative; the other three pairs are correct.

new.s: The nodal ministry of the Deep Ocean Mission is the:
new.x: The Deep Ocean Mission is run by the Ministry of Earth Sciences, approved in June 2021.

new.s: Matsya 6000, India's crewed submersible, is designed to take three people to a depth of:
new.x: Matsya 6000, built by NIOT Chennai, carries 3 people to 6,000 m.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Deep Ocean Mission:
1. It has an outlay of ₹4,077 crore for five years.
2. Samudrayaan is a sub-project of the mission.
3. Matsya 6000 is being built by NIO Goa.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The mission has ₹4,077 crore for five years and includes Samudrayaan; Matsya 6000 is built by NIOT Chennai.

new.s: The Bio-E3 Policy, approved by the Cabinet on 24 August 2024, is steered by:
new.x: Bio-E3 is steered by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT).

new.s: Which of the following is NOT part of the infrastructure planned under the Bio-E3 Policy?
new.x: Bio-E3 plans biomanufacturing hubs, Bio-AI hubs and biofoundries; Technology Innovation Hubs belong to NM-ICPS.

new.s: The Anusandhan National Research Foundation subsumed which body?
new.x: The ANRF, created by the ANRF Act 2023, subsumed SERB.

new.s: The Anusandhan National Research Foundation was created by an Act passed in:
new.x: ANRF was created by the ANRF Act, 2023.

new.s: The IndiaAI Mission (2024) has an outlay of:
new.x: IndiaAI Mission (MeitY) has ₹10,371.92 crore; ₹6,003.65 crore is NQM, ₹76,000 crore Semicon India.

new.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The National Quantum Mission is under MeitY.
2. Semicon India is under MeitY with an outlay of ₹76,000 crore.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Semicon India is a MeitY mission of ₹76,000 crore; the National Quantum Mission's nodal department is DST, not MeitY.

new.s: The National Quantum Mission thematic hub for Quantum Communication is hosted at:
new.x: Quantum Communication hub is at IIT Madras; computing at IISc, sensing at IIT Bombay, materials at IIT Delhi.

new.s: The weather supercomputer Mihir is located at:
new.x: Mihir is at NCMRWF Noida; Pratyush is at IITM Pune.

new.s: The Flosolver supercomputer was developed by:
new.x: Flosolver was developed by NAL Bengaluru; Anupam is BARC's machine.

new.s: PARAM Porul, commissioned in May 2022 under the NSM, is hosted at:
new.x: PARAM Porul is at NIT Tiruchirappalli; PARAM Ananta is at IIT Gandhinagar.
